storeInfo.name: Country Pizza & Restaurant
storeInfo.tagline: Handcrafted New York Style Pizza & Italian Classics in Monroe, CT

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Amplio estacionamiento disponible en el lote privado al frente.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Ample parking available in the private front lot.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Crujientes alitas de pollo bañadas en nuestra salsa picante casera, servidas con aderezo de queso azul y bastones de apio.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature house spicy buffalo sauce, served with blue cheese dressing and celery sticks.

products.descriptionEs: Bastones de queso mozzarella empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con salsa marinara caliente de la casa.
products.descriptionEn: Battered and golden-fried mozzarella cheese sticks, served with warm housemade marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Pan italiano crujiente horneado con mantequilla de ajo fresco y cubierto con una generosa capa de queso mozzarella derretido.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy Italian bread baked with fresh garlic butter and topped with a generous layer of melted mozzarella cheese.
Natural tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil on our artisan crust.
Our signature loaded pizza topped with pepperoni, Italian sausage, mushrooms, bell peppers, onions, and black olives.

products.nameEs: Calzone de Tres Quesos y Jamón
products.descriptionEn: Stone-baked folded dough stuffed with tender ham, creamy ricotta, mozzarella, and parmesan cheese.
Breaded chicken breast topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese, served with a side of spaghetti pasta.
Fresh fettuccine pasta tossed in a rich, creamy garlic butter and parmesan cheese sauce, topped with sautéed shrimp.
Layers of wide pasta, rich meat bolognese sauce, marinara, ricotta, and a blend of melted cheeses baked to perfection.
Crispy pastry shell filled with a sweet, creamy ricotta filling infused with vanilla and dark chocolate chips.
Classic Italian dessert made with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, rich mascarpone cream, and cocoa powder dusting.

products.nameEs: Refrescos de Fuente y Té Helado
products.descriptionEn: Selection of classic fountain sodas or freshly brewed iced tea (free refills available for dine-in guests).

products.descriptionEs: Mejillones frescos de la costa salteados en ajo, vino blanco y salsa marinara ligera, servidos con pan crujiente.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh coastal mussels sautéed in garlic, white wine, and a light marinara broth, served with crusty bread.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares tiernos empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con nuestra salsa marinara casera y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Tender squid rings lightly battered and fried to golden perfection, served with house-made marinara sauce and lemon.

products.descriptionEs: Pan tostado rústico topped con tomates frescos en cubos, albahaca, ajo, aceite de oliva virgen extra y glaseado balsámico.
products.descriptionEn: Toasted rustic bread topped with fresh diced tomatoes, basil, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, and balsamic glaze.

products.descriptionEs: Hongos champiñón grandes rellenos de salchicha italiana picada, hierbas y queso mozzarella gratinado.
products.descriptionEn: Large mushroom caps stuffed with seasoned Italian sausage, herbs, and melted mozzarella cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Queso mozzarella fresco de búfala, rodajas de tomate maduro y hojas de albahaca fresca, aderezado con reducción balsámica.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh buffalo mozzarella, ripe tomato slices, and fresh basil leaves, drizzled with a rich balsamic reduction.

products.descriptionEs: Filete de ternera empanizado cubierto con salsa marinara casera y abundante mozzarella, horneado y servido con espagueti.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded veal cutlet topped with house marinara and melted mozzarella, baked to perfection and served with spaghetti.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo sofrita con champiñones frescos en una rica y aromática salsa de vino Marsala, con puré de papas.
products.descriptionEn: Pan-seared chicken breast sautéed with fresh mushrooms in a rich and aromatic Marsala wine sauce, served with mashed potatoes.

products.descriptionEs: Pasta linguine tierna con almejas frescas del Atlántico en una salsa de ajo, vino blanco y aceite de oliva (o salsa marinara roja).
products.descriptionEn: Tender linguine pasta tossed with fresh Atlantic clams in a garlic, white wine, and olive oil broth (or red marinara sauce).

products.nameEs: Penne a la Vodka con Pollo
products.descriptionEs: Pasta penne corta salteada con trozos de pollo tierno en una cremosa salsa de tomate, vodka y un toque de queso parmesano.
products.descriptionEn: Short penne pasta tossed with tender chicken pieces in a creamy tomato vodka sauce with a hint of parmesan cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Capas de berenjena ligeramente empanizada, salsa marinara, queso parmesano y mozzarella, horneadas hasta dorar.
products.descriptionEn: Layers of lightly battered eggplant, marinara sauce, parmesan, and mozzarella cheeses, baked until golden brown.

products.nameEs: Pizza Estilo Nueva York 'The White Country'
products.nameEn: 'The White Country' NY Style White Pizza
products.descriptionEs: Pizza grande estilo NY sin salsa roja, cubierta con ricotta fresca, mozzarella deshechada, ajo picado y aceite de oliva virgen extra.
products.descriptionEn: Large NY-style pie with no red sauce, topped with fresh dollops of ricotta, shredded mozzarella, minced garlic, and extra virgin olive oil.

products.descriptionEs: Masa crujiente hecha a mano cargada con pepperoni, salchicha italiana, albóndigas caseras, tocino crujiente y jamón.
products.descriptionEn: Hand-crafted crispy crust loaded with pepperoni, Italian sausage, house-made meatballs, crispy bacon, and savory ham.

products.nameEs: Calzone Relleno de Espinaca y Ricotta
products.descriptionEs: Masa de pizza doblada y horneada al horno de piedra, generosamente rellena de espinaca salteada, ricotta cremosa y mozzarella.
products.descriptionEn: Stone-baked folded pizza dough generously stuffed with sautéed spinach, creamy ricotta, and melted mozzarella.

products.descriptionEs: Rollo de masa crujiente relleno de jamón, salami, pepperoni, provolone y salsa marinara por dentro, servido con salsa extra.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy rolled dough stuffed with ham, salami, pepperoni, provolone cheese, and baked marinara, served with extra sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Masa estirada a mano más delgada en el centro con bordes crujientes, queso mozzarella fresco, salsa marinara chunky y albahaca.
products.descriptionEn: Hand-stretched dough thinner in the center with crispy edges, fresh mozzarella cheese, chunky marinara, and fresh basil.

products.nameEs: Limonada casera de Fresa y Albahaca
products.descriptionEs: Refrescante limonada natural hecha en casa infusionada con puré de fresa fresca y hojas aromáticas de albahaca.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing homemade natural lemonade infused with fresh strawberry purée and aromatic basil leaves.

products.descriptionEs: Agua mineral con gas natural italiana, perfecta para limpiar el paladar entre porciones de pizza o pasta.
products.descriptionEn: Italian natural sparkling mineral water, perfect for cleansing the palate between pizza or pasta courses.

products.descriptionEs: Café espresso oscuro e intenso, preparado al momento para el cierre perfecto de tu comida italiana.
products.descriptionEn: Dark and rich Italian roast espresso, freshly pulled for the perfect finish to your Italian meal.

products.descriptionEs: Cerveza lager italiana auténtica, de cuerpo equilibrado y refrescante, ideal para acompañar pizzas y pastas.
products.descriptionEn: Authentic Italian lager beer with a balanced and refreshing body, ideal for pairing with pizzas and pastas.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos pizzas vegetarianas y contamos con opciones de masa sin gluten bajo pedido. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian pizzas and have gluten-free crust options available upon request. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large parties?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones telefónicas para grupos y familias.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and take phone reservations for families and larger groups.

faqs.aEs: Ofrecemos servicio de entrega a domicilio a través de plataformas asociadas locales y pedidos telefónicos directos.
faqs.aEn: We offer delivery service through local delivery partner platforms and direct phone orders.
